people.name: Stephanie
people.body: Pear with a fuller lower tummy, postpartum (baby #5 born spring 2026) and nursing. Bust 42.5", high waist under bust 35", navel 41", hips 47". Long legs, lean calves, shoulders balance hips. Mark the high waist, skim the hip, draw the eye up. YES: V and wrap necklines, waist-length or long open toppers, high-rise straight or wide-leg that sits above the navel, A-line and knee-to-midi hems, woven or structured fabric that falls past the belly, ankle boots. NO: tight bands across the belly, clingy jersey sheaths, gathered or clingy fabric under an empire seam (reads pregnant), cargo or patch pockets on the thigh, hip-length boxy layers, big shoulder volume, low-rise, cropped tops that show skin.
people.life: 6-acre NW Arkansas homestead, five kids under 6, chickens, garden, farm stand, church on Sundays. Clothes must wash easily, survive kids and dirt, and be nursing-friendly when they are tops or dresses.
people.sizeNotes: Tops and dresses: size to the bust, about L/XL or 14-16. Bottoms: size to the hips, about XL/1X or 16-18, tall or long inseam (long legs). Shoe size: not set yet.
wishlist: Everyday fall/winter shoe in taupe, camel, or cognac leather or suede: Chelsea or ankle boot, clog, or leather sneaker (top priority)
Warm brown or olive high-rise jeans or pants, straight or wide-leg, tall inseam
Long cocoa, mushroom, or oatmeal cardigan or duster (knee-length, worn open)
Warm ivory or cream linen or cotton button-down or blouse
Dark high-rise wide-leg jeans with a comfortable waist, tall inseam
True wrap midi dress in a muted, moody floral, matte non-cling fabric, hem below the knee
Fitted nursing bra (only if she has been measured)
